theme: 3 terms for layering and cutting views in SwiftUI: a view on top, a rounded outline and a see-through cut

terms.definition: A modifier that puts another view in front of a view, at the same size.
terms.example: Add the badge as an Overlay on the avatar.

terms.definition: A modifier that cuts a view to the outline of a shape.
terms.example: Use Clip Shape with a circle for the avatar.

terms.definition: A modifier that shows a view only where another view is not transparent.
terms.example: Use a Mask, so the gradient shows only inside the letters.

video.description:
Learn to explain how to layer and cut views in SwiftUI: Overlay, Clip Shape & Mask, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Overlay - A modifier that puts another view in front of a view, at the same size.
Clip Shape - A modifier that cuts a view to the outline of a shape.
Mask - A modifier that shows a view only where another view is not transparent.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Overlay, Clip Shape & Mask in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
오버레이, 클립 셰이프, 마스크 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Overlay - A modifier that puts another view in front of a view, at the same size.
한국어: 오버레이: 어떤 뷰 앞에, 같은 크기로 다른 뷰를 올려 놓는 수정자

Clip Shape - A modifier that cuts a view to the outline of a shape.
한국어: 클립 셰이프: 뷰를 도형의 윤곽선 모양으로 잘라 내는 수정자

Mask - A modifier that shows a view only where another view is not transparent.
한국어: 마스크: 다른 뷰가 투명하지 않은 부분에서만 뷰를 보여 주는 수정자

landscape.hook: Can you explain Overlay, Clip Shape and Mask in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I want a round avatar with a New badge on top.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Start with Clip Shape. It cuts the view to the outline of a shape.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I used `.clipShape(Circle())`, and the corners are gone.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perfect. Clip Shape works with any shape. Now put the badge over it with an Overlay.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It places another view in front, at the same size as the first view.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the New text sits in front of the blue view?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Be careful, the Overlay takes the size of the avatar.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Now I want pink color inside the letters of a title.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is a Mask. It shows a view only where the mask is not transparent.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the pink color appears only inside the text?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. The Mask hides everything outside the letters.
Add the badge as an Overlay.
